title: A code-lane item's done before its merge request merges is caught before land runs, not as an unlanded-code refusal
goal: The cause of ST-6zg57xiu's done refused with reasons=unlanded-code (2026-10-28 09:34 UTC, ops SP-m5m67goe) is named in the item's notes, and the step that ran done before the code-lane merge request merged (a hand done, a land with --wait-merge 0, or a resume) either waits for the merge or says what to run, so the refusal is not the first signal.

run: import subprocess,sys;r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/rag.py','pack','--root','_self','what stops done of a code-lane item before its merge request merges'],capture_output=True,text=True);sys.exit(r.returncode!=0 or 'unlanded-code' not in r.stdout)
